description: DMARC and SPF checker for any domain: grades DMARC, SPF, DNSSEC, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT from public DNS (score and A-F grade), says how easily fake email could be sent in the domain's name and lists the fixes. Also returns daily-updated email security scorecards ranking banks, governments, regulators and telecoms in South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana and 6 more African countries. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

domain.description: Domain to check, e.g. example.co.za (use this or sector)

sector.description: Leave empty when checking a domain. For a ranked scorecard instead, give a sector: banks_insurers, government, metros, regulators_soe, telecoms, all (e.g. banks_insurers)
